correctness.rationale: Three independent uniform 3D spherical vectors give T radial density t/(2ab) on [|a-b|,a+b] and final convolution r h(r)/(4abc). Projecting a uniform 5D sphere to R3 yields conditional radius density 3r²/s³. For the triangle regime L<=c<=U, h=max(0,min(U,r+c)-max(L,|r-c|)) is concave with h(0)=0, so h-rhprime>=0. The proposed explicit nu5 solves the dimension projection identity and integrates to one; its origin gap excludes Phi6. In the nontriangle regime nu3 has origin gap excluding Phi4. Intervals of positive spectral density imply strict PD and dimension nesting completes classification. Independent rational branch integration checked six representative triples for 3D mass=1 and 5D mass=1 in triangle cases, including equality and failure boundaries; full real length result is analytic.
